cast: Lily (girl, 9), her brother Tom (6), Mum, Dad, Grandma, Grandpa, Lily's classmate Mia, cousin Sam (10) and the puppy Max. Core words: Where Is It?.

words.en: The film starts at about six.
more: We talk about school in the car.
我们在车里谈论学校的事。
It's about ten minutes to Grandpa's house.
去爷爷家大约还要十分钟。

words.en: The kite flies above the trees.
words.scene: A colourful kite high in the sky, clearly above a row of green treetops.
more: Look at the bird above the window.
The shelf is above the desk.

words.scene: Lily and Max walking along a stone bridge over a small river, seen from the side.
more: The shop is across the road.

words.scene: Dad standing with his back gently leaning against a closed wooden door, arms crossed.
more: The bike is against the wall.
We play football against Sam's team.
我们和 Sam 的队踢足球。

words.scene: Lily and Tom walking on a path right next to a flowing river, looking at ducks.
more: Ride your bike along the park path.
沿着公园的小路骑自行车。

words.scene: The puppy Max peeking out from a bush full of colourful flowers, only his head and ears visible.
more: The cat is among the boxes.

words.scene: Lily standing in a garden, turning her head to look at butterflies flying in a circle around her.
more: The dog runs around the park.
Come and sit around the fire.

words.scene: Little Tom peeking out from behind a large oak tree trunk, smiling playfully.
more: The dog is behind the gate.

words.en: The fish swim below the boat.
words.scene: A small wooden boat on water, with several colourful fish clearly visible underwater beneath it.
more: Write your name below the picture.
在图画下面写上你的名字。
The path is far below us.
小路在我们下方很远的地方。

words.sz: Mia 坐在 Lily 旁边。
words.scene: Two girls, Mia and Lily, sitting on a park bench right next to each other, reading books.
more: The lamp is beside the bed.
Max 睡在爸爸椅子旁边。

words.en: The ball is between the boxes.
words.scene: A big red ball sitting on the floor between two tall wooden chairs, one chair on its left and one chair on its right, nothing else around.
more: Lily sits between Tom and Max.
Lily 坐在 Tom 和 Max 中间。
The shop is between the bank and the cafe.
商店在银行和咖啡馆之间。

words.en: Our house is close to the park.
words.sz: 我们的房子离公园很近。
words.scene: A small house with a garden, and just a few steps away through a low fence, a playground with swings.
more: The shop is close to the school.

words.scene: Lily running joyfully down a grassy slope, arms out for balance, wind in her hair.

words.en: The cat is in the box.
words.scene: A grey cat sitting comfortably inside a medium-sized cardboard box, looking curious.
more: We play football in the park.

words.en: Tom stands in front of the car.
words.scene: Little Tom standing on the driveway, with a red family car parked directly behind him.
more: There is a tree in front of the house.
Lily walks in front of us.

words.en: The cat is inside the box.
words.scene: A fluffy orange cat sitting comfortably inside a large open cardboard box in a living room.
more: It's raining, so we stay inside.
下雨了，所以我们待在屋里。
Look inside the bag for your toy.
在袋子里找找你的玩具。

words.scene: A happy puppy jumping from a bank into a clear blue pond, splashing water everywhere.
more: Tom puts his toys into the box.
Tom 把他的玩具放进盒子里。

words.en: The park is near our house.
words.scene: A view from a window showing a green park with trees just a short walk away from the house.
more: Come and sit near me, Tom.
Is there a shop near here?

words.sz: Lily 坐在 Mia 旁边。
words.scene: Two girls sitting side by side on a bench in a school playground, smiling at each other.
more: The lamp is next to the bed.
Grandma lives next to the park.

words.scene: Lily reaching up to press a light switch by her bedroom door, the ceiling light just turned off and the room going dark, moonlight from the window.
more: The bus stops here. Get off.
公交车停这儿了。下车吧。

words.en: The book is on the table.
words.scene: A closed storybook lying flat on a wooden table in a bright room.
more: Lily wears a hat on her head.

words.en: The shop is opposite the school.
words.scene: A small corner shop across a quiet street from a primary school building, with children walking between them.
more: Sam sits opposite me in class.
Sam 在教室里坐在我对面。
The park is opposite our house.

words.scene: Children running through an open front door into a sunny garden with flowers.
more: Tom is playing out in the park.
She went out to buy milk.

words.en: He takes the ball out of the bag.
words.scene: A boy reaching into an open backpack and pulling out a red football.
more: She looks out of the window.

words.scene: A snowy garden seen through a window, with bare trees and white ground.

words.en: The dog jumps over the wall.
words.scene: A small dog leaping in mid-air over a low brick garden wall.
more: Look at the plane flying over the house.
The ball goes over the net.

words.scene: Lily and Max walking through an open gate in a garden wall into a sunny park.
more: The train goes through the station.

words.en: The cat is under the chair.
words.scene: A black cat curled up sleeping on the floor underneath a wooden dining chair.
more: The dog sleeps under the table.

words.scene: A girl climbing a ladder-like branch on an oak tree, reaching upwards with her hands.
more: The balloon goes up in the sky.

words.en: Tom is upstairs in his room.
words.scene: A view from the bottom of a staircase looking up to a landing with doors, a boy waving from the top step.
more: Go upstairs and wash your hands.

words.en: We stay indoors when it rains.
words.scene: Lily and Tom looking out of a window at heavy rain, standing inside a warm living room with a cat on the rug.
more: 天很冷。我们在室内玩吧。

words.sz: 我们有一个室内游泳池。
words.scene: A large glass roof above a swimming pool, children swimming inside while snow falls outside the windows.
A wooden table and chairs in a green garden, sunny day, a vase of flowers on the table.
more: The school has an outdoor pool.

words.en: We play outdoors in the park.
words.scene: Lily, Tom and Max running on green grass in a sunny park, trees around them.
Lily kneeling on the grass holding a tennis ball, calling Max who is running towards her.
Tom standing in a park and pointing far away across the grass at a small brown dog sitting under a distant tree; Lily beside him looking where he points.

words.en: Max runs away with Tom's sock.
words.sz: Max 叼着 Tom 的袜子跑开了。
words.scene: A puppy running fast towards the horizon in a field, leaving a red ball behind on the grass.
more: Uncle Ben goes away for work.

words.scene: A classroom view from behind, showing Tom sitting in the first row facing the teacher's desk.
more: The cat sits by the front door.

words.scene: Lily walking on a pavement, Max the puppy trotting closely next to her left leg.
more: There are trees on each side of the road.
Look at this side of the card.

words.en: The bird is at the top.
words.scene: A small blue bird perched on the very highest branch of a tall green tree, looking down.
more: Put it on the top shelf.
把它放在最上面的架子上。
The mountain has a white top.

words.en: The cat is at the bottom.
words.scene: A fluffy cat sitting on the floor at the foot of a wooden ladder, looking up.
more: Tom waits at the bottom of the stairs.
Write your name at the bottom.

words.scene: Three children sitting on a long park bench, Mia is the one in the center seat between two others.
more: There is a lake in the middle of the park.

words.en: The park is in the centre of the town.
words.scene: A town square with a fountain in the exact center, surrounded by shops and trees.
more: The bus goes to the centre.

words.scene: A road stretching far into the distance with hills on the horizon, Lily pointing down the road.
more: Can you walk a bit further, Tom?
